inlines.v: UNCLE'ANNESS, noun 1. Foulness; dirtiness; filthiness. Be not troublesome to thyself or to others by uncleanness 2. Want of ritual or ceremonial purity. Leviticus 15:3. 3. Moral impurity; defilement by sin; sinfulness. I will save you from all your uncleanness Ezekiel 36:17. 4. Lewdness; incontinence. Colossians 3:5. 2 Peter 2:10.
